name: Helping People
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively open their hands and hearts to those in need, recognizing that poverty and hardship persist among God's people (Deuteronomy 15:11). Showing compassion to the poor is likened to lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay such generosity (Proverbs 19:17). A cheerful and bountiful spirit in giving brings blessings, as believers are encouraged to let their good works shine to glorify God (Proverbs 22:9; Matthew 5:16). Jesus teaches that giving should be generous and without hesitation, promising that such kindness will be returned in abundance (Matthew 5:42; Luke 6:38). This includes caring for those struggling with mental illness, reflecting Christ’s love through practical and gracious support.
